c74object.name: evi_valves
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_valves.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_valves.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_valves.genexpr file also requires:
evi_saturators.genexpr
evi_env.genexpr
evi_fastskew.genexpr
evi_rcfilters.genexpr
About this File:
Functions required for the evieve valve distortion emulation evi.valve~, but full of useful nonlinear and enveloping building blocks.

entry.name: safe20dB ( )
entry.description:
In 1: type=input: x, Any audio input
Return 1: Out, Safe audio output as input up to +20dB, after which it is antialiased hard clipped

entry.name: safe40dB ( )
entry.description:
In 1: type=input: x, Any audio input
Return 1: Out, Safe audio output as input up to +40dB, after which it is antialiased hard clipped

entry.name: clipEnv ( )
entry.description:
A very strange envelope based on asymmetrically clipping the input audio and using this data to create positive and negative gain envelopes
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: skew, Skew the asymmetric envelope with an approximated power 0.5..2 around 1
Return 1: ac, Clipped raw absolute audio 0..0.5++
Return 2: env1, Envelope 0..1
Return 3: env2, Envelope 1..0

entry.name: asymExecute ( )
entry.description:
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: skew, Skew the asymmetric envelope with an approximated power 0.5..2 around 1
In 3: type=input: hyst1, Hysterisis envelope 1, leave at '1' to ignore
In 4: type=input: hyst2, Hysterisis envelope 2, leave at '1' to ignore
In 5: type=input: heat, This is a Pete secret and should be left at '1' for normal operation
In 6: type=param (optional): softhard, default: 1, 1 = raw output to outlet 1, 0 = dcblocked output to outlet 1
In 7: type=param (optional): low, default: 2.1, The low value (positive waveform) linear gain multiplier
In 8: type=param (optional): high, default: 3.9, The high value (negative waveform) linear gain multiplier
Return 1: Mix, The mixed asymmetric audio. If @softhard = 0 it is dcblocked.
Return 2: Positive Waveform, Positive only audio tap, dcblocked
Return 3: Negative Waveform, Negative only audio tap, dcblocked

entry.name: atanDriveV ( )
entry.description:
Reciprocal audio wrapper for atan() saturation curve
In 1: type=input: drive, Linear gain >= 1
Return 1: Pre Gain, The gain to apply to the input of an atan() saturator
Return 2: Post Gain, The gain to apply to the output of an atan() saturator

entry.name: diodeCoeffsV ( )
entry.description:
Circuit modelled coefficients calculator for the evieve Diode emulation, for use in 'diodeV()'
In 1: type=input: SR, SAMPLERATE
In 2: type=Param (optional): CR, default: 0.000022, min: 0, max: 0, Constant, do not change
In 3: type=Param (optional): IR, default: 2.2e-13, min: 0, max: 0, Constant, do not change
In 4: type=Param (optional): VT, default: 0.026, min: 0, max: 0, Constant, do not change
Return 1: k1, k1
Return 2: k2, k2
Return 3: k3, k3
Return 4: k4, k4
Return 5: k5, k5
Return 6: k6, k6
Return 7: VT, VT
